taskWorkflow.autoHint: 保存所需资料后，任务按同一套房屋证据规则自动满足，无需另行提交审核。
Saving the required information satisfies this task under the property evidence rules. No separate review submission is required.
taskWorkflow.continuingHint: 这是持续事项：现有记录满足本次证据要求，不代表整段施工结束或以后无需继续。
This is ongoing work. The current record satisfies the evidence requirement; it does not mean construction is finished or future work is unnecessary.
taskWorkflow.recentHint: 这里只显示已保存的条件变化，不表示未读。没有邮件或手机推送。
Shows saved changes to task requirements, not unread messages. No email or phone notifications are sent.
taskWorkflow.noChanges: 尚无新的条件变化记录。既有资料不会被冒充成刚完成。
No new requirement changes recorded. Existing evidence is not presented as newly completed.
taskWorkflow.noNext: 暂时没有其他已安排事项，可在房屋总览检查后续安排。
No other assigned task is available. Check future assignments in the property overview.
taskWorkflow.roadmap: 关键节点、证据清单与工期
taskWorkflow.roadmapHint: 先看房屋整体路线，再处理自己的事项。阶段节点仍按原有事实和授权规则推进。
See the property roadmap before working on your tasks. Milestones retain their evidence and authorization rules.
taskWorkflow.eventMet: 任务条件已满足，系统已更新任务显示
Requirements met; task display updated automatically
taskWorkflow.eventRecord: 本次记录已满足；持续事项仍需跟进
Current record meets the requirement; ongoing work still needs follow-up
taskWorkflow.eventMissing: 条件不再满足，请补充或核对证据
Requirements no longer met; add or verify the evidence
taskWorkflow.saved: 已保存：{{title}}。任务按当前证据更新。
Saved: {{title}}. Task status follows the current evidence.
taskWorkflow.savedNext: 已保存：{{title}}。可在整体路线中查看下一项：{{next}}。
Saved: {{title}}. See the next item in the roadmap: {{next}}.
taskWorkflow.insuranceScope: 此条件只检查保险文件已登记，不证明贷款已办妥或保单有效。
This requirement checks that an insurance document is recorded. It does not establish loan completion or policy validity.
taskWorkflow.utilityScope: 此条件只检查三家水电瓦斯已关闭，不证明保险已取消或退款。
This requirement checks that all three utilities are closed. It does not establish insurance cancellation or a refund.
taskWorkflow.photoScope: 照片必须关联本房、本任务；系统只验证图片格式与关联，不自动判断照片中的现场工作。
Photos must belong to this property and task. The system checks image format and linkage; it does not assess the work shown in the image.
taskWorkflow.evidenceFiles: 本条件对应的照片与文件
Photos and files for this requirement
taskWorkflow.photos_one: 本任务已有 {{count}} 张照片
taskWorkflow.photos_other: 本任务已有 {{count}} 张照片
taskWorkflow.files_one: 本房已有 {{count}} 份所需类型文件
{{count}} document of the required type recorded for this property
taskWorkflow.files_other: 本房已有 {{count}} 份所需类型文件
{{count}} documents of the required type recorded for this property
taskWorkflow.priceHidden: 买入价已记录；金额按原有权限隐藏
Purchase price recorded; amount hidden under existing permissions
